items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy was the straw boss of the band. he used to rehearse the band. So he'd come over to the piano and tell me to play a couple of choruses of the Blues

ctx.x: So the band rehearsed on Wednesday, it rehearsed on Thursday. Our first job was Friday night in Wilmington, Delaware. I'm wondering how in the world that this band, this big band of 17 pieces, is going to play a dance with eight arrangements! Well, I had worked with bands of 13-14 pieces around Washington locally, and everything we played practically was music.

Anyway, we went down, and we started the dance off that night with Dizzy... Dizzy was the straw boss of the band. he used to rehearse the band.
